batting.name: SC Ganguly
batting.dismissal: c S Nadeem b M Morkel

batting.name: KP Pietersen
batting.dismissal: c JD Ryder b R Sharma

balls.text: Pandey doesn't get hold of it this time, the ball rolls towards midwicket and the batsmen take two, Pune end on 146

Morkel keeps it full, heading for off stump, but that is an astonishing shot from Pandey, Morkel did little wrong but he's gone for four, Pandey opens the face and steers that past backward point for four

superb take from the keeper, full and just outside off, a thick inside-edge as the batsman looks to power it through the off side, bounces after the edge on the way through to the keeper, Naman Ojha flings himself to his left to collect that, there's an appeal for caught-behind, but the replays clearly show it bounced soon after taking the edge
bottom hand comes off as he looks to swing that one, doesn't get enough on it but it lands well short of mid-on, batsmen are quick to take two
an inch-perfect yorker from Morkel, squeezed towards third man for a single, this is the highest partnership of the season

a yorker for Morkel, brilliant delivery from him, heading down the leg side, bounces between the batsman's legs and slides down, keeper can't get to it though and that's four byes, Morkel is frustrated
again full and well outside off, squeezing the batsman for room, somehow he manages to dig it out past backward point and down towards third man
a length ball is hammered over cover for four by Uthappa, plenty of power on that one

short and wide outside off, not called a wide though it was well outside the guideline, the umpire deems a legal delivery as Uthappa had shuffled way outside off, Uthappa can't believe the umpire's decision
Pandey was moving across the stumps, Umesh spotted that and sent in a yorker well outside off, Pandey can't get under that, not does he have room to swing his arms, defended
smashed back past the bowler by Pandey, Uthappa scampers back for the second
a full toss to end the over, Pandey works it to midwicket for a single
forced towards long-on for a single this time
an innovative stroke from Uthappa to brings up his half-century, moves across the stumps and scoops it over short fine leg, can't get it all the way to the boundary

four more, and more credit to the batsman this time, powered down the ground, the fielder at long-on, Yogesh Nagar, made a valiant attempt to stop that one, diving to get a hand on it  but he can only deflect it on to the rope
no reward for the bowler here, the batsman was skipping away from leg stump, Morkel follows him and pings in a yorker, an inside-edge from the batsman is enpouh to send it past fine leg for four
Morkel starts with a length ball angling towards the pads, a mistimed lofted shot, rolls towards long-on
look to muscle this shortish ball down the ground, can't time it and it dribbles back to the bowler
a similar shot from Pandey, but doesn't get a boundary as Morne Morkel is on the rope now, just a single
another boundary, a low full toss outside off, Pandey opens the face of the bat to steer it past short third man for four more, that gets the crowd going
pitched up and outside off, Pandey slams that one past long-on for four, he really wanted to hammer that one, gets plenty of power on it
drilled towards long-on for a single
slower one from Umesh, Pandey looks to hammer that towards midwicket, edges it, enough time to take a single, brings up the 100
thumped down the ground to end a terrific over, just four off it
one more reverse-sweep, not enough power on it, wide enough of backward point to get a single
another drop, firmly hit and came towards the bowler a touch low, but he should have taken that, instead  it goes through his legs, still been a very good over so far
hit extremely hard towards Jayawardene at short extra cover, tough to stop that one, through to long-off for a single
two dot balls to start the over, slammed back towards the bowler this time
another reverse-sweep, connects well this time, it's the placement thats off this time, straight to backward point
shot! absolutely hammered by Pandey, gets on the back foot and clubs that shortish ball over deep midwicket, that ends a pretty expensive over from Irfan, 14 off it

full ball just outside off, 131kph, thumped towards long-off for a couple that brings up Pandey's half-century, he hasn't had the best of times this season, batting as low as No. 8 in one game, and then being dropped, he's made the most of his chance this time though
goes for the reverse-sweep, not too well timed, the ball rolls towards short fine leg
full and outside leg, following the batsman, towards square leg for a single
guided wide of short third man for a single
another one-handed hit from Pandey, over the bowler's head, Pietersen races across and does extremely well to stop that from going past the rope
should have only been a couple to long-on, but the fielder there mucks it up to give Uthappa a boundary
slogged off the back foot towards long-on for a single
dropped, punched firmly back towards the bowler, who didn't seem sure at what pace that was coming at him, it was at a nice height for him to puch it, a little to his left, but he makes a hash of it
looks for another powerful hit, can't quite time it, towards long-off for a single
Uthappa charges down, Nadeem fires it in shorter, Uthappa mistimes a heave towards the bowler
Nadeem's final over, he starts with a full ball on middle, worked towards point
shortish ball just outside off, 140kph, flat-batted down towards long-on for a single to end the over
guided towards backward point for another quick single

a one-handed six from Pandey, this was full and wide and a touch slower, Pandey has to reach for it outside off, the bottom hand comes off as he swings hard at it, connects well, well enough to beat long-off for six
shortish ball just outside off, 138kph, Uthappa opens the face and works that towards third man off the back foot
pushed to long-on for a single this time
a boundary to start, not an intended one, a thick outside edge past the keeper for four
guided towards backward point, a tight single is attempted, the throw comes in flat and right next to the stumps for the keeper, Uthappa's perfect dive though saves him
lovely hit from Pandey, cracks this over the bowler's head, bisects mid-on and mid-off, Pune need more of these, the left-arm spinners have got these two batsmen in a bit of a bind so far
lot of turn for Nadeem, Uthappa gets it towards long-off for one more
length ball on leg stump, Pandey gets the front leg out of the way but doesn't go for the heave, helped towards long-on
fired in towards leg stump, Pandey looking to make room but the angle from the left-armer doesn't provide him any, the ball rolls to the leg side
backs away from leg stump, works it towards long-off
looks to power this one down the ground, can't connect well, rolls to long-on
pushed off the front foot towards mid-off for another single, left-arm spinners doing a good job here for Delhi
slapped towards deep cover for a single
punched back to the bowler
defended back towards the bowler
a stifled appeal for lbw as Uthappa looks to sweep, that turns away after pitching on middle and off, hit high on the thigh pad, might have spun past off, quite close that
dances down the track abut can't get that away, a dot ball to end the over
gets the leading edge this time, in the air for a bit but doesn't carry to cover
guided towards backward point, seemed like a tight run that but Pandey was very quick, he was in even if there had been a direct hit
a bit of a mishit there, Pandey was looking to work it to the off side, inside-edge to the leg side, bowler has to chase that one
pushes this one towards point for one more
keeps it full and just outside leg stump, whipped towards deep midwicket
helps this towards deep midwicket for a single
defended by Pandey
worked to long-on by Uthappa for a single

dropped, a full ball is thumped towards long-on, should have been easily taken, reaches KP around waist-high, he seemed surprised that carried all the way to him, through his hands and hit on the midriff, it was a flat hit, not sure how KP make such a meal of it
full and heading down the leg side, worked towards deep midwicket, Uthappa wanted to come back for the second, but decides against it
short of length ball pitching on leg stump, to long-on for one more
worked towards mid-on for one more
looks to hammer that over midwicket, gets the front leg well out of the way and goes for an almighty heave, doesn't connect, edges it to the off side
length ball pitching on middle, hint of spin towards off, defended towards the bowler
pushed towards mid-on this time for an easy single
pushed off the back foot towards extra cover
pushed towards mid-on to end the over, time for the time-out
back to back boundaries, again some width for Uthappa, crunched behind point off the back foot for four more

spins quite a bit this time, but it was very short, that one turns away and Uthappa latches on to it, he was initially skipping away from the stumps but he still managed to reach that one well outside off, powered for four past point
bowled from wide of the crease, not much turn on offer, worked towards square leg
length ball again, batsman backs away from the stumps to make room, slaps it towards point
starts with a length ball on off, defended back to the bowler
a stifled appeal for lbw, it was pitched up by Morkel, just outside off, batsman looks to drive but gets a thick inside-edge to the leg side
full and on middle stump, another single towards mid-on, more comfortable run this time
length ball on middle and off, pushed past short extra cover for a sharp single
length ball on off stump, 146kph, pushed towards mid-on and a single is scrambled, the throw from a diving mid-on misses the stumps
Morkel reverts to his usual back of a length, just outside off, Pandey lets it through to the keeper, a rare sight in T20s
the first six of the game, Morkel is slammed over mid-off by Pandey, it was pitched up, Pandey doesn't bother too much with the footwork, just launches that for six, nice timing on that
overpitched on the leg stump, whipped towards deep midwicket by Pandey
slower ball, 110kph, short of length and on off stump, Uthappa plays with soft hands towards backward point and takes the single
this time Uthappa gets it right, the ball was closer to the off stump and he manages to glide it down to Morkel at third man
backs away from the stumps and pushes the ball towards point, straight to the fielder
on the stumps this time, blocked towards the bowler
Irfan sends this wide of off stump, 128kph, Uthappa chases after it in an attempt to help it along to third man, doesn't connect
shorter and closer to the stumps, Pandey decides to play that on the front foot, defended off the front foot
pitched up and a bit of width, 145kph, Pandey gets half a stride forward and drives that past a diving point fielder for a boundary, Pune beginning to get a move on now
shorter and wider, 143kph, batsman stays on the back foot and guides it down towards third man
pitched up this time, a crisp drive, just wide of mid-off, gives enough time for the batsmen to take a single
on middle stump this time, 144kph, worked towards midwicket, immediately calls for a single
starts with a short of length ball heading for the off stump, 142kph, defended by the batsman, that stayed a bit low
defends the final ball of the over to the off side
the first boundary of the game, gets his front leg out of the way and whips a shortish ball from Irfan towards the wide long-on boundary
looking to force that one through the leg side, Pandey skips down the track and flat bats it towards midwicket, can't beat the fielder
opens the face to guide an off stump delivery towards deep backward point for a single
length ball on off stump, 131.7kph, pushed towards mid-off, too firmly to take a single
short of length and angling across Uthappa, who fishes at that one and misses
shortish and just outside off, steered down to third man for a single, after two overs 2/2
defends a length ball towards cover, thinks about a single and then decides against it
Uthappa guides that towards backward point, bit of confusion as Pandey was keen on a single and rushed down but Uthappa wasn't interested, Pandey gets back in time though
two down! Ganguly charges out and looks to hammer that over the off side, gets a thick outside edge, flies down towards third man and Ganguly follows Ryder back to the pavilion, 1/2 now Pune
lovely drive from Ganguly, doesn't place it too well, cover fields it and no run for Ganguly
pushed towards cover, and that is a dot ball, super over from Irfan that
a hint of swing for Pathan, keeps it tight around the off stump, defended by Pandey
a bbit of width, chopped towards backward point for a single, Ganguly and Pune are on their way
Ganguly watchfully defends his first delivery

Irfan has struck, the dangerous Ryder is dismissed for a duck. Ryder looks to push this back of a length ball, it stays low and hits the bottom of the bat before crashing into the stumps, terrific start this for Delhi
back of a length, just outside off, punched towards mid-off by Ryder

and finishes it in style, a short ball from Rahul, Sehwag waits for it and thumps it over long-on for six to complete an utterly dominant win for Delhi Daredevils, a fist pump from Sehwag to celebrate the win
pitched up and swung past point for four, that was a thick outside edge, Sehwag was looking to go over extra cover
rocks back and chops that wide delivery towards point
gets back in the crease and whips it to deep midwicket for a single
and easy single for Taylor, to midwicket
chips it just wide of short cover, Wright dives but he can't reach that
fuller and on middle, defended off the front foot to the leg side
Sehwag checks his drive, not hit too hard, just past a diving bowler, Ferguson has to do the fielding again
worked towards square leg for one more
thumped powerfully down the ground. Callum Ferguson has to dive at long-on to cut that off
on middle stump this time, easy single wide of mid-on, sixth single for Taylor as he moves to 6
length ball on off stump,defended off the front foot
full and very wide, just within the permissible limits I think, certainly the umpire thinks so
length ball outside off, Taylor pushes to point to bring Sehwag back on strike
swipes this towards midwicket for a single
that is a poor delivery, very short from Rahul, all too easy for Sehwag, who just has to decide where to put that away, he stabs it over backward point for a boundary
shortish and just outside off, punched off the back foot towards mid-on
full and very wide, Sehwag reaches out for that and hits it towards extra cover
length ball on leg stump, clipped to midwicket for one more to end the over
full and heading for leg stump, Taylor is wisely just working the ball around for the singles, this time to midwicket
fired down the leg side, Taylor can't get bat on it
looks to cut that one and doesn't connect
eased to long-off for a single

short of length ball goes straight on, whipped off the back foot by Sehwag, seemed like he had hit it hard enough to get a single or two, but that gallops to the boundary, evading deep midwicket, what timing and placement
spins away after pitching on a length, slapped in front of point for a single
eased to short fine leg for a single
looking to paddle-sweep this time, edges it on to the pads, the ball rolls towards point
towards midwicket for a single, no confusion this time

shorter and wider, Taylor cuts it firmly towards backward point, a slight misfield, Sehwag wanted a quick single, he had already taken a few paces and then on seeing the misfield, started to sprint, Taylor didn't want a run, Sehwag has time to get back
length ball on offstump, helped towards extra cover

Rahul Sharma strikes, KP is gone, Pune aren't rolling over without a fight, KP wanted to slam that over the leg-side, gets a bit of a top edge, the ball soars high but only as far as Ryder at mid-on, it was in the air a long time but Ryder doesn't make a mistake
a half-volley outside leg stump, Sehwag dismisses that over square leg for a boundary that takes Delhi to Nelson, 111/1 in 11 overs
slanting down leg once more, another single towards midwicket, no need for risks
shortish ball heading down the leg side, only 104 kph that, Sehwag wanted to help that past short fine leg but the lack of pace meant the fielder could get around in time
full and heading for the toes, Sehwag swings his bat to send that towards wide long-on, KP pushes for the second
eased towards long-off for a single, required rate is a mere 4.75 now
Wright's back, he starts with a back of length ball outside off, helped towards long-on for a single, the hundred comes up, Delhi cruising here
shorter and outside off, chopped towards point for a single that brings up his half-century
full toss  from Murali, Sehwag isn't going to miss those, launches it over the bowler's head and beats a diving deep fielder to get a boundary
inside-edge onto the pads as he looks to whip that to the leg side off the back foot
pushed towards mid-on for a single
KP gets on the back foot and cracks this towards sweeper cover, Luke Wright has to sprint across and put in a dive to stop it from reaching the rope
worked towards deep midwicket for a single
not this time, looks to sweep powerfully and gets a bottom-edge towards square leg
a big six from KP, a short of length ball, KP gets the  front leg out of the way and a clean swing sends the balls into the stands beyond long-on, he really does make it look easy
again Sehwag moves beyond leg to make room, slaps it towards sweeper cover for a single
full and down the leg side,Sehwag looks to glance it, off the pads and past the keeper for four leg-byes
off the back foot, towards cover for a single
Rahul starts with a short ball, gets away with it, drilled to long-on for a single
fuller and on the pads, Sehwag helps it along to midwicket, they think of two before Sehwag screams 'No, no,"and it's just one
moves beyond leg stump and works that one towards sweeper cover
big stride forward as he defends
short of length, and a controlled chip over the bowler's head, absolutely no feet from Sehwag as he play that, lands well short of long-off
length ball is worked towards cover
just outside off, sliced to backward point for a single

terrific placement from Sehwag, a short of length ball is whipped past midwicket and wide of long-on, that's four more for Sehwag, he rattling along, 40 off 18 now. Pune need to get him fairly quick, else this is going to be utterly one-sided
KP shuffles a couple of feet beyond leg stump even as Ganguly runs in, driven towards long-on for one more
short of length ball, defended by KP
length ball on middle and leg, pushed towards long-on by Sehwag
109kph from Ganguly, forced towards the sweeper cover by Sehwag
not as good a start as the other day, short of length and just outside off, Sehwag backs away to make room and slices that past backward point for four

and Delhi are in a hurry here, pitched up invitingly by Nehra, Pietersen accepts and launches that over long-on, it crashes into the boundary hoarding, six more to Delhi, time for the Pune spinners to work their magic
no power at all from KP as he hits that length ball,drives it on the up for an eye-catchingly effortless straight-drive for four
length ball on middle and leg, pushed towards mid-off, and another dangerous moment there, Sehwag always wanted one but he had to put the skates on to make it in time
fuller length and on middle and leg, 140kph, defended to the off side off the front foot
good comeback from Nehara, 139kph, gets this short of length ball to bounce extra, Sehwag is surprised and ends up playing inside the line of it
Sehwag finding it easy here, a 140kph delivery from Nehra, back of a length and outside off, just a bit of width, that's enough for Sehwag to stab the ball past backward point for four
length ball on off and middle, KP pushes it towards midwicket to end the over
one more slower one, rolling his fingers across the seam, short of length and well outside off, 113 kph, KP defends it down the ground
another slower one, 116kph, shorter and outside off this time, guided towards backward point
Wright getting a warm welcome to the IPL, that is pitched up and Sehwag dismisses that slower one, thumped over long-on for six
terrible delivery that as fine leg was up, it was fired down the leg side, Sehwag just had to help that freebie along to the fine leg boundary, he doesn't miss out
starts with a length ball, pushed towards mid-on for an easy single
short of length again from Nehra, 139kph, a bottom-edge as Sehwag looks to crash that from outside off towards midwicket, misses the stumps and runs away to the fine-leg boundary
full and slightly slower, just outside off, pushed towards mid-off by KP to get off the mark
full and on middle and leg, KP defends carefully

back of the length and on the pads this time, another whip towards square leg, a diving stop, and more confusion in the middle, Sehwag again takes a few paces and stops, watching the ball all the time, then he decides to go through for the single and KP responds
Sehwag goes for the pull, like Jayawardene earlier he ends up lofting it in the air towards mid-on, easily clears Ganguly though, who has another chase
short of length ball around off and middle, Sehwag whips that in front of square leg for a boundary
pitched up, just outside off, 139.7kph. pushed towards extra cover by Kevin Pietersen

a run-out! utter confusion in the middle, some dreadful running there, the ball is angled into the pads, Sehwag tucks it towards square leg where Wright is waiting, both batsmen set off for a run, Sehwag stops after taking 3-4 paces, and for a moment both batsmen are running towards the keeper's end, Sehwag then continues to try for the single, Jayawardene had no chance, and he was yards out when the stumps are broken
a bit more width this time, guided down towards third man for a single
pitched up and just outside off, Jayawardene mishits that over the bowler's head, it has enough on it to clear mid-on though, and Ganguly chases after it
shorter this time, Jayawardene goes for the pull again, this time he connects well enough, gets it wide of mid-on for a boundary
length ball heading for off stump, defended towards square leg by Jayawardene
short ball, on middle and leg, 136kph, Jayawardene looks to pull that one, can't time it properly, the ball rolls towards square leg
on the pads, easy for Jayawardene, glanced towards fine leg for a boundary
on middle and leg, length ball is defended to the leg side
short of length and on leg stump, a leading edge sends the ball towards point
length ball just outside off, punched back past the bowler towards mid-off for a single
Nehra starts with a length ball on the pads, defended to the leg side, a quick single taken
angling into the pads, Jayawardene was looking to pick up another boundary towards fine leg, off the pads and the ball dribbles towards square leg, Jayawardene unhappy at missing out on that
fuller and quicker, 140kph, just outside off, blocked to the off side by Jayawardene
slower bouncer from Thomas, 112kph, Jayardene spots it early, that was heading down the leg side, Jayawardene helps it along wide of fine leg for a boundary, nicely done by the Sri Lankan captain
shortish once more, Sehwag jumps as he looks to work that to the leg side, gets a single
short of length and on off stump, 133kph, Jayawardene gets deep in the crease and works the ball towards square leg
loses his line, short and angling well down leg, Jayawardene wanted to help that along to the deep backward square leg boundary but doesn't connect
Thomas starts with a length ball outside off, 137.5kph, seams away a bit, Jayawardene lets it go
